what: the receive elastic buffer rate_match_gp (own gray-pointer FIFO, two clock domains)

bench.description: every case of test_rate_match_gp_cocotb (cocotb + Icarus, output for output against the Python twin, frame checks), run in two stages: same_clocks, partner_faster, ordered_sets_and_errors_pass, lock_loss_discards, clear_wins_over_a_count; then, for a mutant that survives those, partner_slower, minimum_gap_partner_faster and (added by brief 152) pause_right_after_a_frame_start, writer_outruns_a_reader_held_in_reset

timeout_policy: A bench run that exceeds its time limit is `timed_out`: it is not counted as killed and not as a survivor; it is listed, and the worst-case score counts it as a survivor. A formal run that exceeds its limit is `undecided`, handled the same way. Neither is ever counted as a kill.

filter.method: miter: BMC, then register-matched induction (yosys equiv_induct), then an unbounded proof (sby)
filter.compared: every output of the block, at every step (both clocks free)
filter.start_state: registers without an initial value start at 0 in both versions

redecided.why: these survivors were undecided at the first limits (BMC timed out under machine load)
